title: Connect ChatGPT or Claude
subtitle: AI apps allowed to read your JoyoRogo data. Read-only: nothing can be changed or deleted through a connection.

connector.title: Connector address
connector.hint: Paste this address into Claude or ChatGPT when you add a connector.
connector.guide: Guide: use Claude or ChatGPT with your JoyoRogo data

consent.title: Share your data with an AI app?
consent.intro: When you add the connector address to an AI app, that app can read your JoyoRogo data and send it to the company that runs it. Before the address is shown, please read what is shared and who gets it, and agree.
consent.to: Anthropic (Claude), OpenAI (ChatGPT), or the company behind the other AI app you connect. Each app you connect is a separate recipient, and once the data reaches it, that company's privacy terms apply.
consent.lead: What a connected AI app can read:
consent.how: Only when that AI app asks for it, for example when you ask it a question, and only through your JoyoRogo account, after you sign in and allow the app on joyorogo.com. Read-only: nothing can be changed or deleted.
consent.notSent: GPS routes, photos, Strava data and your password.
consent.choice: It is your choice. Without your agreement the address stays hidden. You can withdraw any time on this screen: withdrawing hides the address and disconnects every connected app at once. You can also disconnect one app below.
consent.privacy: Read the privacy policy (AI connection section)
consent.agreedAt: You agreed to share your data with AI apps on {{date}}.
consent.review: What is shared and who gets it
consent.withdrawBody: The address is hidden again and every connected AI app is disconnected right away, so none of them can read your data any more. You can agree again any time.
consent.withdrawnAll: Agreement withdrawn. Every AI app was disconnected.
consent.withdrawnPartial: Agreement withdrawn, but some apps could not be disconnected. Disconnect them below.

list.title: Connected apps
list.empty: No AI app is connected yet.
list.emptyHint: Connect from Claude or ChatGPT and the app shows up here.
list.error: Could not load your connections. Try again.

revoke.title: Disconnect {{name}}?
revoke.body: {{name}} can no longer read your data, right away. You can connect it again any time.

activity.title: Recent activity
activity.hint: Every time an AI app reads your data it is logged here for 90 days. What is logged: the tool used and its date range, never the data itself.

profile_read.label: Profile and targets
profile_read.desc: Mode (lose, maintain, gain, pregnant), height, age, start and target weight, calorie and protein targets.

food_read.label: Food log
food_read.desc: The food you log each day with calories and macros, and daily totals against your target.

weight_read.label: Body weight
weight_read.desc: Weigh-in history, waist measurements and the trend toward your target.

workouts_read.label: Workouts
workouts_read.desc: Workouts from your JoyoFit watch (duration, distance, heart rate, analysis) and strength sessions. No GPS routes.

recovery_read.label: Sleep and recovery
recovery_read.desc: Hours slept, recovery, readiness, resting heart rate, HRV, VO2max and steps from JoyoFit or Health Connect.
